## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** All in-scope atoms (including untriggered branches: debt-withheld replacement tier, no-IU and no-SMC tiers, two-parent tiers, pension-overpayment-debt tier, the retired surfaces) are carried at the same strength; every factor ladder is complete and exact in its own document; every prerequisite sentence is verbatim on its blocked side only, in its declared form. First revision; no earlier revision exists.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
1. `comp_ext_returned_payment_replacement` declares superseded the base clause "A reissue repeats the gross amount of the payment it replaces" while its own `baseline.rule` is "A replacement repeats the gross amount of the payment that came back". The KB renders both faithfully (`monthly_entitlement_rule_3f494a12` §8 retired; `replacement_amount_basis_5767657b` baseline), so a reader sees a retired clause and a baseline with the same content. It does not change any task-0 answer (the comparison factor's first tier applies).
2. The source states a retro span only for the decision past-due ("Its span runs from …"); the spans of the dependency and opening releases are derived (GT traces derive them from the months rules and the payment start lag). The KB carries what the source carries.
